pay_detail: Wages start at $15.50 an hour, about 20 hours a week (2026).
duration: 8-week summer internship. The library page does not give dates.
name: Wanda Fullmore Youth Internship Program
org: Common Wealth Development with the City of Madison
what_you_do: An 8-week summer internship with mandatory training and weekly professional development. The library page says it is organized by Common Wealth Development for Madison youth to get involved with local government.
who_can_apply: Students who are at least 14 years old when they apply. They must live in the City of Madison limits or attend a Madison Metropolitan School.
deadline_text: The library page does not post 2026 or 2027 dates. Check with Common Wealth Development.
how_to_apply: The library page does not list application steps. Call Madison Public Library at 608-266-6300 or Common Wealth Development at (608) 256-3527.
notes: The library page says the program has mandatory pre-internship training and weekly professional development during the internship. The Common Wealth Development website was under construction when checked, so confirm details with them before applying.
